param.name: zensical.site.name
param.desc: Site name. Defaults to the map title.

param.name: zensical.site.url
param.desc: Canonical site URL, for example https://docs.example.com/.

param.name: zensical.site.description
param.desc: Site description used in page metadata.

param.name: zensical.repo.url
param.desc: Source repository URL shown in the header.

param.name: zensical.config
param.desc: Your own zensical.toml. The plug-in adds nav and extra_css under [project] when the file does not define them.

param.name: zensical.home
param.desc: Generate docs/index.md from the map when no topic is published as index.md.

param.name: zensical.admonitions
param.desc: Render DITA notes as Zensical admonitions.

param.name: zensical.theme.tables
param.desc: Let the Zensical theme style DITA tables (moves the DITA class to data-dita-class).

param.name: zensical.highlight
param.desc: Syntax-highlight codeblocks with pymdownx.highlight, as Zensical does for fenced code.

param.name: zensical.code.default-lang
param.desc: Language for codeblocks without outputclass='language-*'. Default: text.

param.name: zensical.python
param.desc: Python interpreter Zensical is installed in; runs the adapter. Found automatically when unset.

param.name: zensical.source.links
param.desc: Add a link on every topic page to its DITA source: in a git repository, or in the AEM Guides DAM.

param.name: zensical.source.action
param.desc: Which of Zensical's page-action buttons to show for the source: edit, view or both.

param.name: zensical.source.root
param.desc: Local folder that corresponds to the repository root or the DAM URL root. Default: the git checkout root (git) or the map's folder (aem).

param.name: zensical.aem.dam-url
param.desc: DAM URL root for aem links, such as https://author.example.com/assetdetails.html/content/dam/docs. The topic path is appended, or replaces {path}.

param.name: zensical.aem.view-url
param.desc: DAM URL root for the view button, when it should differ from zensical.aem.dam-url.

param.name: zensical.git.url
param.desc: Repository web URL for git links. Default: zensical.repo.url, then the origin remote.

param.name: zensical.git.branch
param.desc: Branch for git links. Default: the checked-out branch, or the commit when detached.

param.name: zensical.git.host
param.desc: Git host URL style. Default: guessed from the repository URL.

param.name: zensical.source.url-template
param.desc: Full URL template overriding the git or aem preset (edit button, and view unless set below). Placeholders: {path} {raw_path} {repo} {branch} {topic_id}.

param.name: zensical.source.view-url-template
param.desc: Full URL template for the view button.

param.name: zensical.stage
param.desc: Last step to run: interchange (DITA-OT output only), sources (docs/ and zensical.toml), site (zensical build).

param.name: zensical.executable
param.desc: Zensical command to run. Default: zensical (must be on PATH).

param.name: zensical.strict
param.desc: Pass --strict to zensical build.
